reviewerRole: Independent synthetic-user QA: recreational 5K runner, sub-20 aspiration

profile.label: 5K rekreativac sub-20
profile.historySource: Synthetic QA scenario; not a real athlete

reproduction.result: Both regenerated hashes match; both original summaries and all three session/prediction/QS audits have zero arithmetic/coherence failures.

issues.expected: Report entered 23:45 result as current reference, without treating plan completion as confirmed fitness improvement.
issues.actual: vdot0=40.7 but vdotGoal=44.2 and predictedSec=1329 (22:09), an unverified 96-second improvement; warning describes what the plan realistically delivers. New uses vdotGoal=vdot0=40.7 and predictedSec=1425 (23:45), and explicitly says this is not a race-day progress estimate.
issues.impact: Athlete may interpret generated forecast as a demonstrated route toward sub-20.

issues.expected: Preserve aerobic-I session purpose after dose reduction: the implementation documents a >=60-second minimum for I repetitions; shorter legs need a different stated purpose or format.
issues.actual: I pyramid100-200-300-200-100m at272sec/km, with61sec walking between legs. Leg times27.2,54.4,81.6,54.4,27.2sec; four of five below60sec. Working dose0.9km/244.8sec. Label remains Piramida, zoneI; copy only states dose adapted.
issues.evidence: U02-event.json audit.details week9 g9d3; web/src/domain/training/sessions/constraints.ts I minimumRepM comment and interval branch, absent from pyramid branch
issues.impact: Data are internally coherent, but trimming changes an aerobic interval workout toward brief surges while retaining its I label. This is a policy/purpose mismatch, not a medical safety diagnosis.

issues.expected: Underexecution reduction without confirmed break should explain reduced load without asserting a pause.
issues.actual: All26 past eligible runs are explicitly done; daysSinceLastRun=0, recommendation=reduce, options={}, executionAdjustment.breakDays=0. Three future day descriptions nevertheless say Postepen povratak posle pauze.
issues.evidence: U02-event.json input.log, analysis, adjustment.result.meta.executionAdjustment and week8 descriptions; web/src/domain/plan/returnGrowth.ts
issues.impact: User can wrongly infer that the application detected a break, even though the recommendation correctly avoided it.

browser.scope: Await centralized evidence; no browser/export/watch/real-user claim in this report.

verdict: Prefer new for evidence honesty, reported-base long-run fit, introductory quality and true deloads; residual adjustment purpose/copy defects need correction. No severe or high issue observed in U02 domain execution.
